Episode 184. Overcoming Fate (21)
'Ah, this little one… Even though he insists on fighting alone, I’m strangely not anxious.'
Numerus's recovery would have depleted his energy again, and the monster might still have some hidden tricks up his sleeve.
Yet, watching Jin confidently walking towards the beast, I didn't feel anxious at all.
Even beyond that, I couldn't even imagine Jin losing to the beast.
I don't know why. It's just a hard-to-explain confidence that comes as an intuition. Jin's rune of Kandel is shining brighter than that of the beast.
'He's grown a lot while I wasn't looking.'
Murakan turned around and exhaled into the storm of soul energy.
His breath, like tearing a roll of paper, pierced one side of the storm, creating an exit for Murakan.
[When the fight is over, I might be gone. But we'll meet again soon, so wait and keep the strawberry pie safe.]
"Confess directly after you go out. Gilly will be fighting too."
[A confession, how childish... Wait, this crazy kid! Did you bring the strawberry pie here? To such a dangerous place?]
"She insisted on participating in the battle."
[Even so! Ah, I have to go check now!]
In fact, Gilly was unable to participate in the battle because she had not fully recovered from the injuries she had sustained in the previous fight.
Murakan didn't see Jin's smile and hastily exited the storm of soul energy.
[Strawberry pie-!]
At the sound of Murakan's voice that shook the entire battlefield, everyone in the outer battlefield looked up at the sky.
Looking at Murakan, who was spreading his wings and staring at the ground, not only the enemies but also the allies couldn't help but be overwhelmed.
[Anyone who harms my strawberry pie will not be able to step on this land alive again! Anyone, I, Murakan will certainly not let them live.]
"What, what is he saying!?"
"What is a strawberry pie?"
"Why did he come out alone leaving the 12 trainees behind?"
In the midst of life and death, such a sudden confession would confuse anyone.
The savvy colleagues, roughly understanding the situation, touched their foreheads in embarrassment, and the allies were confused trying to understand the meaning of his words.
However, the power Murakan possesses is real.
In an instant, he pulled the retreating allied forces out of the crisis and ruthlessly crushed the enemies with his overwhelming strength.
Once again, when Murakan unleashed a roar filled with anger, the knights of chaos clutched their heads and faltered in large groups.
Even though their bodies were incapable of feeling pain, they were overwhelmed by the intensity of Murakan, the black dragon.
Among the allies, those with weaker mental strength also took a hit from Murakan's roar.
There were allies who fell, spewing blood from every hole in their faces.
However, this was by no means an act that put the allies at further risk.
Rather, it was closer to a kind of shock therapy. Those who had fallen were all losing consciousness due to the psychic attack of the monster until they heard Murakan's roar.
As painful as it might be, the roar was waking them up from the psychic attack.
[That's quite an impressive force... Has he regained all his strength from his heyday?]
Zephyrin spoke with a trembling voice. She was shuddering at the energy of Murakan.
[No, he has come close, but it is still not as good as a thousand years ago.]
At Orgal's response, Zephyrin suppressed her surprise.
[...Is that true, master?]
[Yes. Now you understand why I told you never to fight Murakan, even when I was well?]
[I do.]
[Go support Murakan, Zephyrin. That's not to say give him more strength, but help protect our allies so he can fight more freely.]
Zephyrin's eyes widened.
Orgal was implying that the war would end in victory just by doing that.
[Understood.]
Zephyrin flew near Murakan, and from the Zipfel side, Veradin, who had opened the magic stone again, stepped forward.
He too had the same thought as Orgal as soon as he confirmed the power of Murakan.
Through the insight derived from Solderet's divine stature, Murakan immediately recognized that he was Veradin, not Kelliark.
Knowing what Jin thinks about Veradin, Murakan gave him a short and weighty word.
[You can come back, Veradin Zipfel. So don't commit too many sins before that.]
Veradin didn't respond but spread his magic widely to expand a protective shield.
‘After the final battle, I must prepare for the war as soon as possible by confirming the current conditions of the god of war and Murakan....’
It was troubling. It was shocking enough when the god of war manifested, but if Murakan is intact too, Zipfel's fate after today would inevitably be overwhelming.
[More than that, the strawberry pie.]
[If you mean the nanny of Jin, she didn't participate in this battlefield from the beginning.]
[Darn, I was fooled by that little guy and lost my cool. Well, it doesn't matter. Even better. Now that I know that the strawberry pie is safe, I'll calmly knock these guys out.]
Black chains made of spirit energy stretched from Murakan's two wings. Thousands of black chains fluttered in the sky like ominous tentacles.
Spirit Energy Release - Black Shackles
Like a shower, the chains of spirit energy were driven into the upper part of Ram all at once.
Despite the massive chains pouring down, there was absolutely no sound of an explosion.
Only the sound of the top of Ram being struck and bursting continued.
The forces of chaos lost their formation in an instant as they tried to avoid the chains.
[Oh, so those are the resurrected former generation head families.]
Among the numerous chains, only four failed to stick into the top of Ram and were cut or bounced off.
The last four heads of the previous generation had cut them with swords.
However, the effect was extremely minimal. They had only managed to deflect a single one of the many chains falling towards them.
[Kid... No, since the 12 knights and sub-head family of Runcandel aren't here, I'll speak on their behalf. I will revoke the privilege called Runcandel that has been given to you.]
As soon as Murakan finished speaking, the top of Ram began to boil with spirit energy. Foam-like spirit energy was rising from the embedded chains.
[Those who follow the 12 knights, do not avoid the spirit energy.]
The allies, who had been reflexively trying to avoid the foam, stopped their movement.
Even when the spirit energy touched them, they didn't suffer any damage.
On the other hand, the enemies trapped in the foam were melting away. It was as if sand was sinking into the sea and turning into mud.
Spirit energy release is both the beginning and the end of manipulating shadows.
Murakan was now showing one aspect of the end of spirit energy.
Without even an act that could be called a fight or battle, he simply made the opponent disappear into his shadow. The Black Shackles at their pinnacle possessed such power.
Among the forces of chaos trapped in the foam, those worthy of being called elite were resisting the spirit energy and maintaining their form.
But it was only a matter of time.
If the forces of chaos could not resist like this, the enemies would soon be buried in their shadows and reduced to nothingness.
It was as if a massive sieve was filtering out the impurities of chaos.
[Hear me, knights of Runcandel. Taking the heads of those who were former heads of families is your job, so get moving.]
Mary and Tona brothers raised their swords to the sky.
"We'll obey!"
"Hee, Sister Mary. Can I join too?"
"Of course, Yona, you kill that guy over there. Tona guys, you take left and right, I'll take the center."
"Hehe."
The knights who had reached their respective previous generation head families didn't need to engage in intense battle.
The previous head families were already trapped in the Black Shackles, unable to even move properly.
The reason why Murakan specifically ordered the children of Runcandel to kill them was for symbolism.
He wanted to show everyone that Runcandel of now could cut off the rotten roots and move forward again.
The Black Shackles showed no signs of stopping. On the contrary, it was getting deeper beyond comprehension.
Moreover, Murakan even deployed the ultimate technique of another spirit energy release, not just the Black Shackles.
Suddenly, the central part of Ram opened like an eyeball, revealing a main cannon that was thought to be completely destroyed.
The other main cannon that Ram had hidden, without any signs of reloading, spewed dark flames straight towards Murakan.
It was a power similar to what Ram had shown before being broken by Vahn.
But Murakan gathered all his breath and repelled the cannon fire without any problem.
Murakan's breath was dividing the huge black beam shot from Ram in half.
Ram's cannon fire only split like a rotten tree and scattered around the battlefield as fragments.
Zephyrin, Veradin, and the heroes of Inse spread out a protective barrier to protect the allies from the fragments.
Murakan's breath not only tore through the cannon fire but also broke the monstrously erected main cannon again, creating a huge hole in the upper part of Ram.
Yet Murakan seemed unsatisfied, thinking to himself.

'Even though I shot with the full power I can muster now, only that much is broken? Tch, I would look weaker than the War God of the Myoung Clan. Besides, the War God completely destroyed this spaceship when it was intact.'
Of course, contrary to Murakan's thoughts, the allies were aghast looking down at the hole opened like a cliff.
[Now my time is almost up. Everyone, stand up and fight again. Show that you can end the war safely even after this black dragon Murakan leaves.]
The allies, who had been still, lifted their swords and staves again.
They spit out the blood in their mouths, reset broken bones, and quickly wrapped torn wounds with bandages.
They had all been moving even before Murakan's command.
All the allies had hope and evil on their faces at the same time.
For the last time, Murakan looked at the sky on the other side where Bale and Padler were fighting.
The fact that their fight was taking place far away from the central battlefield was because Padler had led it that way.
'Padler Runcandel, I wanted to keep that guy alive if possible….'
Murakan could see it.
The chain of chaos tied to Padler's heart.
Padler now knew the existence of the chain tied to his heart. He just didn't reveal the fact, thinking it was too late.
'...Tell Sarah hello for me, Padler.'
Sadness filled the eyes of Murakan, who began to return to the realm of gods.
